baseline_models.focus_anchor: The earning/falling pair at words 5 and 7 is opposed to intentional fitting work and the great bounty at words 11-12 and 23-24.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first cohort's self-acquisition returns as a fixed descent upon them. The second cohort contributes intentional, fitting action, but its result exceeds exchange because the destination is named as benefaction and surplus.

activation_trace.role: Self-directed acquisition supplies the stock whose consequence returns to its acquirers.
Falling together with fixation turns acquired action into an event now attached to them.
Purposive action marks the second cohort's real contribution.
Fitness and suitability make those acts constructive rather than merely numerous.
Unowed benefaction makes the final good exceed a wage-equivalent return.

changed_reading.before: A symmetrical punishment-for-bad and reward-for-good contrast.
changed_reading.after: An asymmetrical economy: harmful acquisition becomes its own arriving liability, while fitting work is answered by a gift larger than exchange.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The falling event at word 7 and the paired meadow, garden, and Lord terms at words 14, 15, and 20.
baseline_models.mechanism: The destination is a maintained habitat rather than decorative scenery: falling water, watering to saturation, tree-made enclosure, and gradual nurture compose a cultivated shelter.

activation_trace.role: Falling rain supplies the material descent that can feed the garden side of the contrast.
Watering until saturation makes the meadow an achieved condition of sufficiency.
A tree-enclosed orchard provides both growth and shelter.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the continuing maintenance of the habitat.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are a static reward backdrop.
changed_reading.after: The gardens are a saturated, enclosed, continuously tended ecology, set against a destructive kind of falling.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Seeing at word 1, fearful concern at word 3, fixed arrival at word 7, and concealment in the garden term at word 15.
baseline_models.mechanism: Vision, twilight-like fear, arrival, and concealment stage a threshold: hidden acquisition becomes perceptible as consequence, while the good destination remains a protective enclosure rather than public exposure.

activation_trace.role: Sensory or inward sight makes disclosure the frame of the whole scene.
The residual red light at sunset supplies a boundary image between visibility and darkness.
A fall that settles converts anticipation into disclosed actuality.
Covering and concealment make the believers' hiddenness protective rather than evasive.

changed_reading.before: The opening verb simply asks the addressee to observe two outcomes.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is also about a change of visibility: concealed deeds become an undeniable event, while sheltered life remains safely covered.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Desire at word 18 is governed by nearness at word 19, Lordship at word 20, and benefaction at word 23.
baseline_models.mechanism: Desired things are not presented as autonomous possessions. Their availability is located in nearness to the nurturing sovereign and summarized as gift, making relation the container of fulfilled desire.

activation_trace.role: Will directed toward things supplies desire without yet supplying ownership or production.
Proximity and presence locate fulfillment within a relation.
Sovereignty and ownership identify who holds the desired good.
Free benefaction identifies the mode by which desire is fulfilled.

changed_reading.before: The believers receive an unlimited inventory of whatever they want.
changed_reading.after: Fulfilled desire is relational availability near their Lord, received through benefaction rather than independent control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier gathering is explicitly divided into two separated groups, one in a garden and one in a blaze. The focus ayah becomes a close view of the states produced by that public sorting.

activation_trace.role: The enclosed orchard anchors the favorable destination in the focus.
A day and place that gathers people supplies the collective event behind the focus scene.
Separated cohorts turn the focus's conjunction into an adjudicated division.
The same orchard destination links the earlier group directly to the focus's believers.
Ignited fire supplies the adverse destination that the focus leaves implicit in the falling consequence.

structural_cues: 42:7 already pairs a group in the garden with a group in the blaze; 42:22 re-presents the bifurcation through fear and security.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, separated groups, garden, and blaze; I infer that 42:22 zooms into that same sorting. A live alternative is that 42:7 supplies only a thematic template, not an identical scene.

changed_reading.before: Two moral types are placed side by side.
changed_reading.after: The two types are viewed after a gathering has separated them into opposed destinations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, unbelievers hurry the Hour while believers fear it and know it is real. In the focus, fearful concern has migrated to the wrongdoers and the feared reality is no longer merely near: it is falling upon them.

activation_trace.role: Fear mixed with vigilant concern marks the wrongdoers' changed posture.
Settled arrival advances the scene from a nearing event to contact with its subjects.
Hurrying and bringing forward supplies the unbelievers' earlier, reckless posture toward the event.
The same concerned fear belongs earlier to believers, making its later transfer diagnostic.
Reality fixed against falsehood explains why the believers' earlier fear is lucid rather than panicked.

structural_cues: 42:17 calls the Hour near; 42:18 assigns concern to believers and haste to unbelievers; 42:22 reverses the emotional ownership.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated fear term and the near-to-falling sequence; I infer a temporal reversal at the same judgment horizon. The fear in 42:22 can still be read more narrowly as fear of deeds within that horizon.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers happen to be frightened by punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their fear is a belated acquisition of the posture believers held earlier, after reckless haste has become unavoidable arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: Desire selects a crop, cultivation produces a harvest, and increase exceeds the seed. The focus's garden therefore mediates between work and a result repeatedly enlarged through appreciative benefaction rather than paid at parity.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition anchors the negative side of the focus's productive economy.
Purposive work anchors the positive human input.
Saturated cultivation gives the harvest sequence a material destination.
Surplus beyond need or division names the excess yielded by the process.
Human willing chooses which harvest is sought and links desire to cultivation.
Sowing and tillage turn the two outcomes into rival cultivated futures.
Growth and increase supply the arrow from crop sought to crop enlarged.
An acquisition that clings to its doer links good acquisition back to the focus's harmful acquisition.
A little input showing an abundant effect explains amplification without wage-equivalence.
The explicit benefaction in the increase sequence confirms that enlargement is gifted.

structural_cues: 42:20 places two harvests immediately before the focus; 42:23 and 42:26 repeat increase after good acquisition and after righteous work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies desire, crop, acquisition, increase, and benefaction; I infer that the focus garden is the realized harvest in this sequence. The live alternative is that the garden remains a destination image without describing the process of reward.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds purchase a garden reward.
changed_reading.after: Righteous work is seed in an amplified harvest: the garden is cultivated continuity, while the great bounty is the gifted excess over its input.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding wrongdoers participate in instituting an order attributed to partners without authorization, while decisive separation and judgment are deferred. Their focus-ayah fear is therefore attached to mislocated authority, not only private misconduct.

activation_trace.role: Putting something in the wrong place anchors the focus label as a disorder of proper authority.
Entering and opening an affair supplies the act of instituting the rival order.
Permission supplies the missing authorization that makes the institution wrongful.
A judgment separating true from false supplies the pending adjudication.
A cutting, binding decision explains why the consequence is delayed but fixed.
The repeated label directly carries the preceding institutional disorder into the focus.

structural_cues: 42:21 ends with the wrongdoers and their painful outcome; 42:22 begins by showing those same-labeled people fearing what they acquired.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rival partners, unauthorized institution, deferred judgment, and the repeated wrongdoer label; I infer continuity into 42:22. A live alternative is that the focus deliberately widens the label beyond the actors of 42:21.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers are an undifferentiated class of bad individuals.
changed_reading.after: At least one live referent is people who relocate norm-giving authority and then face the order their own institution produced.

context_deltas.mechanism: Unbounded worldly provision would produce transgression, so provision descends by measure; rain then descends after despair and spreads mercy by reviving growth. The focus garden becomes governed abundance: fully watered, but not the same as uncontrolled expansion.

activation_trace.role: Rainfall lets the focus's falling term participate in a life-giving descent as well as punitive descent.
Watering to saturation supplies the receiving ground for measured rain.
Thickening and intertwining vegetation supplies the visible product of that watering.
Expansion and abundance supply the dangerous counterfactual of provision without calibration.
An apportioned gift identifies abundance as distributed provision, not self-generated stock.
Measured planning supplies the control that prevents abundance from becoming transgression.
Life-giving rain supplies the material intervention after despair.
Rain reviving dried pasture supplies the arrow from descent to renewed habitat.
Tender mercy identifies the rain's social and affective value, not just its material effect.

structural_cues: 42:27-28 follows the focus's promise with a contrast between excessive spread, measured descent, rain after despair, and mercy spread.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured provision, rain, revived vegetation, and mercy; I infer that this sequence materializes the focus's watered gardens. The alternative is that the rain is a general analogy for mercy rather than a specification of the garden.

changed_reading.before: Great bounty means simply maximal quantity.
changed_reading.after: Great bounty is an expertly governed ecology: abundance arrives in the measure that can sustain life without reproducing transgression.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later causal formula makes a striking event arise from what hands acquired, but immediately says that much is erased from liability. The focus's falling consequence is therefore not a claim that every wrong mechanically lands; it can be the remainder after extensive pardon.

activation_trace.role: Self-acquisition anchors the focus's causal language.
A fall that fixes in place anchors the arriving consequence.
A calamity that strikes a person supplies the later parallel to falling upon them.
The repeated acquisition root explicitly preserves the causal link to action.
Hands as earners make agency concrete and block displacement of responsibility.
Leaving punishment and erasing fault interrupts a total one-to-one retribution rule.
Abundant quantity makes pardon a major subtraction rather than a marginal exception.

structural_cues: 42:30 repeats the acquisition-to-impact grammar but closes with pardon of much.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies causal impact and abundant pardon; I infer that what finally falls may be non-pardoned residue. The alternative is that 42:30 concerns temporal adversity while 42:22 concerns final judgment under a different accounting scope.

changed_reading.before: Every acquired wrong returns through an exhaustive mechanical equivalence.
changed_reading.after: Agency still has consequences, but the visible liability may be what remains after a large, prior act of pardon.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later contrast classifies whatever is merely given here as temporary use, while what is in divine presence is better and remains for believers who rely on their Lord. This makes nearness, not quantity alone, the durability mechanism of the focus promise.

activation_trace.role: Proximity and presence anchor where the promised good is held.
Continuance and abiding support the persistence of nearness.
Useful enjoyment supplies the limited category against which focus bounty is measured.
The repeated proximity construction identifies divine presence as the location of the superior good.
Chosen excellence ranks that held good above temporary use.
Continuance supplies the temporal property missing from worldly enjoyment.
Lordship joins enduring good to trust in its sovereign holder.

structural_cues: 42:36 repeats divine proximity and the believers' Lord relation while explicitly contrasting temporary and enduring goods.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the temporary-versus-enduring contrast and repeated proximity; I infer that proximity is what secures the focus promise's durability. The alternative is that proximity is idiomatic possession language with no distinct spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Whatever they desire is chiefly an unlimited quantity of objects.
changed_reading.after: The promise's decisive feature is that desired good is held in enduring nearness, unlike useful but expiring worldly grants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later believer portrait makes fitting work social: deliberation, expenditure, proportionate defense, pardon, and reconciliation. It also narrows wrongdoing toward people to transgression beyond right, while protecting the wronged person's defense from that label.

activation_trace.role: Dealings among people make righteous work relational rather than merely private.
Removing estrangement gives the positive category a repair mechanism.
Withholding people from their rights gives the negative category a social object.
Extracting judgment through mutual review supplies a communal form of fitting action.
Wealth leaving its holder as expenditure reverses self-enclosing acquisition.
Forgoing punishment and erasing fault interrupts reciprocal escalation.
Reconciliation supplies the constructive goal of pardon.
Withholding human rights identifies who bears the adverse label in the legal sequence.
Crossing the limit through aggression distinguishes wrongdoing from proportionate defense.
Restraining the self from reactive collapse makes repair a sustained discipline.

structural_cues: 42:37-43 unfolds one continuous social portrait after 42:36's promise to believers, including an explicit distinction between defense after wrong and aggression against people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies these practices and legal distinctions; I infer that they instantiate the focus's two class labels. They may instead be selected examples under categories broader than this social mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds and wrongdoing are abstract moral totals.
changed_reading.after: They are visible social processes: consultation, circulation, restraint, and repair oppose withholding rights and transgressive aggression.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's act of seeing is replayed as the wrongdoers themselves see punishment, seek a route of return, are displayed upon it, and look only from a concealed edge. Public exposure and impaired looking invert the believers' protective concealment.

activation_trace.role: Mutual facing makes sight relational: observer and observed occupy one disclosed scene.
Protective covering anchors the favorable alternative to punitive exposure.
Repeated facing joins the addressee's sight to the wrongdoers' belated sight of punishment.
Return to a former place supplies the reversal they seek but cannot obtain.
A traversable path supplies the missing route out of the fixed event.
Being brought out for inspection turns the wrongdoers into publicly exposed objects.
Concealment contracts their own gaze even while their bodies are exposed.

structural_cues: 42:44 repeats both seeing and the wrongdoer label; 42:45 immediately expands the optics into display, abasement, and a hidden glance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the verbal reprise and exposure/hidden-looking sequence; I infer that it expands the focus's visual mechanics. The alternative is that the later scene is a second depiction rather than an unpacking of the focus.

changed_reading.before: The addressee neutrally sees frightened wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: The scene is an exposure regime: wrongdoers become fully visible just as their own sight contracts, while believers receive shelter rather than shame.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence repeatedly attaches willing to the creator and pairs it with giving without exchange. Human desire in the focus is therefore fulfilled inside a prior architecture of divine creation and gift, not by a second sovereign will.

activation_trace.role: Human will directed toward desired things anchors the promise that needs contextual scaling.
Sovereign ownership locates human willing under Lordship.
Benefaction identifies gift as the fulfillment mode.
Originating creation supplies the productive capacity behind available things.
Repeated divine willing places the same root on the creator side of the relation.
Giving without compensation supplies the concrete mode of divine provision.

structural_cues: 42:49-50 repeatedly alternates divine willing, creating, and gifting, after the focus locates human willing near the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated will root with changed subject plus creation and gift; I infer nested rather than competing wills. A live alternative is that the focus describes a transformed human will whose objects already harmonize with divine willing.

changed_reading.before: Human desire becomes an independent power to generate any object.
changed_reading.after: Human desire is freely fulfilled within the Lord's creative and gift-giving will; proximity grants access without transferring sovereignty.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant alternate mapping from the seeing root to a water-satiation root. It remains worth carrying because falling rain, saturation, enclosed vegetation, and later rain all converge on focus anchors. Downstream prose should present it as a latent water echo, never as a replacement translation of the opening verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening sight term, the falling term, and the meadow/garden pair at words 1, 7, 14, and 15.

activation_trace.role: The packet's alternate mapping contributes satiation after thirst as a form-distant echo behind the opening sight.
Rainfall gives the otherwise punitive descent a second, life-giving material possibility.
Watering to saturation realizes the alternate echo in the destination itself.
Dense vegetal growth supplies the result of received water.
Later life-giving rain verifies that the surah itself sustains the material circuit.

changed_reading.before: The two halves are linked only by moral contrast.
changed_reading.after: A secondary water circuit links them: one descent becomes fixed harm, while another descent answers thirst and produces the sheltered garden.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the twilight branch of fearful concern and extends an affective word into an optical sequence. It remains anchored through seeing, concealment, later exposure, hidden looking, and the surah's explicit light. Downstream prose should qualify it as an image-pattern, not claim that the fear term lexically means a complete light theology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Seeing and fearful concern at words 1 and 3, together with the concealed garden at word 15.

activation_trace.role: Sight supplies the governing optical action.
Sunset redness contributes unstable residual visibility at a threshold.
Covering supplies a hidden state that may protect rather than obscure truth.
Public display moves wrongdoers from twilight uncertainty into forced visibility.
Their hidden glance preserves impaired sight inside public exposure.
Explicit illumination supplies the opposite endpoint: light that enables guidance rather than exposure alone.

changed_reading.before: Fear is purely emotional and the opening sight is neutral.
changed_reading.after: The focus may sit at an optical threshold: wrongdoers retain only twilight-like, contracting vision, while guided sight belongs to a light that can coexist with protective concealment.

strongest_changes: The fear term reverses ownership between 42:18 and 42:22: believers fear while the Hour is near, but wrongdoers fear once consequence is arriving.
The harvest, increase, and appreciative-gift sequence turns the garden from a wage into an amplified crop whose excess is benefaction.
Measured rain and revived growth make the bounty a governed ecology rather than uncontrolled quantity.
The repeated acquisition-impact formula is interrupted by abundant pardon, revising strict mechanical retribution.
The later legal-social sequence makes righteous action into consultation, circulation, restraint, and repair, and defines wrongdoing through violated rights and aggression.
The later seeing scene expands the focus into an inversion of visibility: wrongdoers are exposed while their own gaze contracts.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah repetition repeatedly changed the focus without collapsing it to one reading: fear changed temporal ownership, work became cultivation, bounty became amplified yet measured provision, and sight became a relation between exposure and shelter. The packet's non-dominant water mapping and twilight branch also produced contained but live cross-domain readings.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the group split in 42:7 is the identical scene viewed in 42:22 or a recurring template.
Whether pardon in 42:30 limits final liability in 42:22 or only explains temporal adversity.
How human fulfilled desire relates to repeated divine willing: nested access and transformed desire both remain live.
The hydrological and twilight models are packet-anchored but may be branch-driven echoes rather than intended organizing mechanisms.
